high_level_description: The image shows a person taking a mirror selfie in what appears to be a bathroom or a similar indoor setting. The individual is standing against a plain white wall with a tiled floor visible at the bottom of the frame. The person has dark hair styled upwards and is wearing a patterned short-sleeved shirt with a leafy design in shades of gray and black over a white undershirt. They are also wearing dark jeans and a watch on their left wrist. The person is holding a smartphone in their right hand, which they are using to take the photo. Their left hand is partially tucked into their pocket.
